notes: Run 2026-11-11. WebFetch only worked for URLs that surfaced in web search results (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED for others): NTU Veterinary Hospital (vh.ntu.edu.tw homepage), TVMA, MOA animal.moa.gov.tw, Taipei and New Taipei animal protection office pages and their clinic lists, and every clinic's own website could not be opened. NTU hospital PDFs opened were cancer-centre referral forms with no emergency/24 h statement, so NTU, NCHU and NPUST teaching hospitals are not listed. All entries therefore rest on secondary pages (Royal Canin holiday list, udn, Line Today); emergency_24h is true only where such a page explicitly says 24 h (holiday-period statements are noted) and these need confirmation on the clinics' own pages by the independent check. No animal poison information line found (the only poison centre page opened, Taipei Veterans General Hospital, is for humans); none listed. Kenting/Hengchun: nothing found that could be opened. Left: official Taipei/New Taipei holiday clinic lists, Tainan/Kaohsiung/Hualien/Taitung own-site data, university teaching hospitals, Kenting. Independent check 2026-11-11: all source pages reopened; 24-h claims confirmed on the source_url page except 大安 (downgraded). Own clinic sites and Taipei 24h registry PDF blocked by robots.txt; not used. Orchestrator 2026-11-11: 11 entries with only holiday-period 24-h statements downgraded to not 24 h; remaining 24-h flags rest on secondary pages (no own site opened).
